lessons: SKILL_HE.md has no YAML frontmatter, unlike peer skills in this repo. Harmless for sync, but worth adding for consistency.
Deferred MINOR: no administrative-fee section (medical certificate, magnetic card, record copies), which is a routine member question. Leumit and Clalit both publish tariffs.
Deferred MINOR: senior (72+) dental tariffs are published by Clalit and a housebound mobile-dental route by Leumit; the skill says only that adult dental is out of basket.
Deferred MINOR: Leumit's per-km fuel reimbursement for oncology/dialysis transport is more generous than the generic rule stated.
Deferred MINOR: children of separated parents, newborn kupah assignment and the 45-day objection window.
Maccabi still publishes no consolidated tariff table and Meuhedet's pages are client-rendered: both need a browser, curl will not do.
The two vintages (circular 1/2025 vs each kupah's 2026 page) must be labelled per row; this cycle found unlabelled circular-era figures sitting beside 2026 ones.
The MoH circular series is now headed חוזר האגף לפיקוח על קופות החולים ושירותי בריאות נוספים; search both names.
Still no 2026 payments circular as of 2026-09-20 (sbn02-2026 through sbn07-2026 all 404; sbn01-2026 is a child-development circular).
Meuhedet's tier ORDER (עדיף then שיא) rests on domain knowledge: the reachable page pairs the two names without ranking them. Cite a ranking page or keep it unasserted.
Checklist B2 originally attributed seven Meuhedet §14.3 line items to Maccabi, a page-adjacency read of the circular PDF. Always read the per-kupah block, never a neighbouring one.
verify-evidence --check-sources cannot catch a claim whose TEXT outruns its snippet, only a snippet absent from the page. Diff claim against snippet by hand.

Roll-up evidence entries (statutory-copay-table-1-2025, clalit-tariffs-2026, leumit-tariffs-2026, meuhedet-copays, er-clinical-presentations, er-full-exemption-circumstances) bundle many figures behind a single label snippet.
